smart_money_top: Marine Port Services (sustained #1, ROC +43.14%, +87 ranks in one day)
summary: Three-act geopolitical whipsaw drove a sharp risk-on reversal: peace-talk reports, a brief Trump threat to strike Kharg Island, then a call-off and declaration the Iran conflict is 'settled, subject to finalization' - the Dow reversed Wednesday's -900 with a +900 swing. SPX +1.75% to 7394.30, NDX +3.29% to 29446.18, VIX -12.5% to 19.44. WTI -5.76% to an 8-week low of $86.52, completing a full round-trip of the Hormuz war premium; Energy was the lone red sector (XLE -1.94%) while Technology (XLK +3.73%) and Materials (XLB +3.27%) led. Semis were the epicentre of the rally - SOXX +8.39%, MU +11.66% on the day's largest turnover, INTC +9.27% on a BofA double upgrade - while AI capex payers (ORCL -8.53%, ADBE -6.25%) sold off in a capex receiver/payer bifurcation. PPI headline +6.5% y/y (hottest since Nov 2022) but core soft at +4.9%, the first inflation test for new Fed Chair Kevin Warsh. Gold +3.34% and silver +5.86% on a falling-VIX day signalled an inflation/weak-dollar trade rather than a haven bid. SpaceX's record IPO prices Friday with retail allocation cut to the low 20s and Polymarket pricing a $2T cap.
